starting-the-quest-talking-to-edmond.speaker: Edmond
starting-the-quest-talking-to-edmond.text: Sorry, I can't stop to talk...

starting-the-quest-talking-to-edmond.speaker: Edmond
starting-the-quest-talking-to-edmond.text: I've got to find my daughter. I pray that she is still alive...

steps.speaker: Edmond
steps.text: Elena's a healer. Three weeks ago she managed to cross the wall into West Ardougne. No one's allowed to cross the wall in case they spread the plague.

steps.speaker: Edmond
steps.text: Not that long ago, West Ardougne was hit by a deadly plague. They had the wall built to try and keep it contained. No one is allowed to enter the city now apart from the mourners.

steps.speaker: Edmond
steps.text: They say the plague is a horrible way to go... That's why Elena felt she had to go help. She said she'd be gone for a few days but we've heard nothing since.

steps.player: Maybe I could help find her?

steps.speaker: Edmond
steps.text: Really, would you? I've been working on a plan to get into West Ardougne, but I'm too old and tired to carry it through. But you on the other hand, you should have no problem.

steps.speaker: Edmond
steps.text: If you're going into West Ardougne you'll need protection from the plague. My wife made a special gas mask for Elena with dwellberries rubbed into it.

steps.speaker: Edmond
steps.text: They help to repel the plague apparently. We need some more though...

steps.player: Where can I find these dwellberries?

steps.speaker: Edmond
steps.text: The only place I know of is McGrubor's Wood, just west of Seers' Village. The berries are bright blue so they're easy to spot.

steps.player: Okay, I'll go and get some.

steps.speaker: Edmond
steps.text: The foresters keep a close eye on it, but there is a back way in.

steps.player: On second thoughts, I'd better not.

steps.speaker: Edmond
steps.text: Well if you hear anything about Elena please tell me.

starting-the-quest-talking-to-edmond-bef.speaker: Edmond
starting-the-quest-talking-to-edmond-bef.text: Have you got the dwellberries yet?

starting-the-quest-talking-to-edmond-bef.speaker: Edmond
starting-the-quest-talking-to-edmond-bef.text: You'll probably find them in McGrubor's Wood, just west of Seers' Village. The berries are bright blue so they're easy to spot.

starting-the-quest-talking-to-edmond-bef.player: Okay, I'll go and get some.

starting-the-quest-talking-to-edmond-bef.speaker: Edmond
starting-the-quest-talking-to-edmond-bef.text: The foresters keep a close eye on it, but there is a back way in.

starting-the-quest-talking-to-alrena-bef.player: Hello, Edmond has asked me to help find your daughter.

starting-the-quest-talking-to-alrena-bef.speaker: Alrena
starting-the-quest-talking-to-alrena-bef.text: Yes he told me. I've begun making your special gas mask, but I need some dwellberries to finish it.

starting-the-quest-talking-to-alrena-bef.speaker: Alrena
starting-the-quest-talking-to-alrena-bef.text: The best place to look is in McGrubor's Wood, just west of Seers' Village.

starting-the-quest-talking-to-edmond-aft.speaker: Edmond
starting-the-quest-talking-to-edmond-aft.text: Have you got the dwellberries yet?

starting-the-quest-talking-to-edmond-aft.speaker: Edmond
starting-the-quest-talking-to-edmond-aft.text: Take them to my wife Alrena, she's inside.

starting-the-quest-talking-to-alrena-aft.player: Hello, Edmond has asked me to help find your daughter.

starting-the-quest-talking-to-alrena-aft.speaker: Alrena
starting-the-quest-talking-to-alrena-aft.text: Yes he told me. I've begun making your special gas mask, but I need some dwellberries to finish it.
You give the dwellberries to Alrena.
Alrena crushes the berries into a smooth paste. She then smears the paste over a strange mask.

starting-the-quest-talking-to-alrena-aft.speaker: Alrena
starting-the-quest-talking-to-alrena-aft.text: There we go, all done. While in West Ardougne you must wear this at all times, or you could catch the plague.
Alrena has given you a gas mask.

starting-the-quest-talking-to-alrena-aft.speaker: Alrena
starting-the-quest-talking-to-alrena-aft.text: I'll make a spare mask for you in case you lose that one. I'll hide it in the cupboard in case the mourners come looking.

starting-the-quest-searching-the-cupboar.text: If the player already has the gas mask:

steps.text: You search the cupboard but you find nothing.

starting-the-quest-searching-the-cupboar.text: If the player has no inventory space:

steps.text: You find a protective mask but you don't have enough room to take it.

starting-the-quest-searching-the-cupboar.text: If the player does not have the gas mask:

steps.text: You find a protective mask.

starting-the-quest-talking-to-alrena-aft.speaker: Alrena
starting-the-quest-talking-to-alrena-aft.text: Hello darling, I think Edmond had a good idea of how to get into West Ardougne, you should hear his idea.

starting-the-quest-talking-to-alrena-aft.player: Alright, I'll go and see him now.

starting-the-quest-talking-to-edmond-aft.player: Hi Edmond, I've got the gas mask now.

starting-the-quest-talking-to-edmond-aft.speaker: Edmond
starting-the-quest-talking-to-edmond-aft.text: Good stuff, now for the digging. Beneath us are the Ardougne sewers. I've done some research, and I reckon you can use them to enter West Ardougne.

starting-the-quest-talking-to-edmond-aft.speaker: Edmond
starting-the-quest-talking-to-edmond-aft.text: I've already tried digging down to them but the soil is rock hard. You'll need to pour on several buckets of water to soften it up. I reckon four buckets should do it.

starting-the-quest-talking-to-edmond-bef.player: I still need to pour four more buckets of water on the soil.

starting-the-quest-talking-to-alrena-bef.speaker: Alrena
starting-the-quest-talking-to-alrena-bef.text: Hello darling, how's that tunnel coming along?

starting-the-quest-talking-to-alrena-bef.player: I just need to soften the soil and then we'll start digging.

starting-the-quest-talking-to-alrena-bef.speaker: Alrena
starting-the-quest-talking-to-alrena-bef.text: Well I'm sure you're quicker than Edmond.

starting-the-quest-digging-the-mud-patch.text: You dig the soil... The ground is rather hard.

starting-the-quest-interacting-with-the-.text: If Edmond has not told the player to pour water:

steps.text: You see no reason to do that at the moment.

starting-the-quest-interacting-with-the-.text: If this is the first, second, or third bucket of water:

steps.text: You pour water onto the soil. The soil softens slightly.

starting-the-quest-interacting-with-the-.text: If this is the fourth bucket of water:

steps.text: You pour water onto the soil. The soil is now soft enough to dig into.

starting-the-quest-interacting-with-the-.text: You dig deep into the soft soil... Suddenly it crumbles away! You fall through into the sewer. Edmond follows you down the hole.
You climb up the mud pile.
You climb down into the hole.

starting-the-quest-talking-to-mourner-ou.speaker: Mourner
starting-the-quest-talking-to-mourner-ou.text: You and that Edmond fella, you're looking very suspicious.

starting-the-quest-talking-to-mourner-ou.player: We're just gardening. Have you heard any news about West Ardougne?

starting-the-quest-talking-to-mourner-ou.speaker: Mourner
starting-the-quest-talking-to-mourner-ou.text: Just the usual, everyone's sick or dying. I'm furious at King Tyras for bringing this plague to our lands.

starting-the-quest-talking-to-edmond-aft.player: I still need to pour three more buckets of water on the soil.

starting-the-quest-talking-to-alrena-aft.speaker: Alrena
starting-the-quest-talking-to-alrena-aft.text: Hello darling, how's that tunnel coming along?

starting-the-quest-talking-to-alrena-aft.player: I just need to soften the soil a little more and then we'll start digging.

starting-the-quest-talking-to-edmond-aft.player: I still need to pour two more buckets of water on the soil.
I still need to pour one more bucket of water on the soil.
I've soaked the soil with water.

starting-the-quest-talking-to-edmond-aft.speaker: Edmond
starting-the-quest-talking-to-edmond-aft.text: That's great, it should be soft enough to dig through now. There should be a spade nearby that you can use.

starting-the-quest-talking-to-alrena-aft.speaker: Alrena
starting-the-quest-talking-to-alrena-aft.text: One of the mourners has been sniffing around asking questions about you and Edmond, you should keep an eye out for him.
If the player does not have a gas mask:

steps.speaker: Alrena
steps.text: Also, don't forget about that spare gas mask if you need it. It's hidden in the cupboard.

starting-the-quest-talking-to-alrena-aft.text: If the player has a gas mask:

starting-the-quest-talking-to-mourner-ou.speaker: Mourner
starting-the-quest-talking-to-mourner-ou.text: What are you up to with old man Edmond?

starting-the-quest-talking-to-mourner-ou.player: Oh, you know about that then?

starting-the-quest-talking-to-mourner-ou.speaker: Mourner
starting-the-quest-talking-to-mourner-ou.text: We know about everything that goes on in Ardougne. We have to if we are to contain the plague.

starting-the-quest-talking-to-mourner-ou.player: Have you see his daughter recently?

starting-the-quest-talking-to-mourner-ou.speaker: Mourner
starting-the-quest-talking-to-mourner-ou.text: I imagine she's caught the plague. Either way she won't be allowed out of West Ardougne, the risk is too great.

starting-the-quest-talking-to-edmond-in-.speaker: Edmond
starting-the-quest-talking-to-edmond-in-.text: I think it's the pipe to the south that comes up in West Ardougne.

starting-the-quest-talking-to-alrena-aft.speaker: Alrena
starting-the-quest-talking-to-alrena-aft.text: Hi, have you managed to get through to West Ardougne?

starting-the-quest-talking-to-alrena-aft.player: Not yet, but I should be going soon.

starting-the-quest-talking-to-alrena-aft.speaker: Alrena
starting-the-quest-talking-to-alrena-aft.text: Make sure you wear your mask while you're over there! I can't think of a worse way to die.
If the player does not have a gas mask:

steps.speaker: Alrena
steps.text: Don't forget, I've got a spare one hidden in the cupboard if you need it.

starting-the-quest-talking-to-alrena-aft.text: If the player has a gas mask:

starting-the-quest-talking-to-mourner-ou.speaker: Mourner
starting-the-quest-talking-to-mourner-ou.text: Your hands are covered in mud.

starting-the-quest-talking-to-mourner-ou.speaker: Mourner
starting-the-quest-talking-to-mourner-ou.text: Funny, you don't look like the gardening type.

starting-the-quest-talking-to-mourner-ou.player: Oh no, I love gardening! It's my favorite pastime.

starting-the-quest-talking-to-mourner-ou.speaker: Mourner
starting-the-quest-talking-to-mourner-ou.text: If I find you attempting to cross the wall I'll make sure you never return.

starting-the-quest-interacting-with-the-.text: If the grill has not been removed:

steps.text: There is a grill blocking your way.

starting-the-quest-interacting-with-the-.text: If the player is not wearing a gas mask:

steps.speaker: Edmond
steps.text: I can't let you enter the city without your gas mask on.

starting-the-quest-interacting-with-the-.text: You climb up through the sewer pipe.
The grill is too secure. You can't pull it off alone.

starting-the-quest-interacting-with-the-.player: Maybe I should try opening it first.

starting-the-quest-interacting-with-the-.text: You tie the end of the rope to the sewer pipe's grill.

starting-the-quest-talking-to-edmond-aft.player: Edmond, I can't get through to West Ardougne! There's an iron grill blocking my way, I can't pull it off alone.

starting-the-quest-talking-to-edmond-aft.speaker: Edmond
starting-the-quest-talking-to-edmond-aft.text: If you get some rope you could tie to the grill, then we could both pull it at the same time.

starting-the-quest-talking-to-edmond-aft.player: I've tied a rope to the grill over there, will you help me pull it off?

starting-the-quest-talking-to-edmond-aft.text: The player and Edmond pull on the rope, opening the grill on the pipe.

starting-the-quest-talking-to-edmond-aft.speaker: Edmond
starting-the-quest-talking-to-edmond-aft.text: Once you're in the city look for a man called Jethick. He's an old friend of the family. Hopefully he can help you.

entering-west-ardougne-talking-to-edmond.player: Not yet, it's a big city over there.

entering-west-ardougne-talking-to-edmond.speaker: Edmond
entering-west-ardougne-talking-to-edmond.text: I hope it's not too late.

entering-west-ardougne-talking-to-alrena.speaker: Alrena
entering-west-ardougne-talking-to-alrena.text: Is there anything else I can do to help?

entering-west-ardougne-talking-to-alrena.player: It's alright, I'll get her back soon.

entering-west-ardougne-talking-to-alrena.text: If the player does not have a gas mask:

steps.speaker: Alrena
steps.text: That's the spirit, dear. Don't forget that there's a spare gas mask in the cupboard if you need one.

entering-west-ardougne-talking-to-alrena.text: If the player has a gas mask:

steps.speaker: Alrena
steps.text: That's the spirit, dear.

entering-west-ardougne-interacting-with-.text: You climb down through the manhole.
You pull back the manhole cover.

entering-west-ardougne-opening-doors-to-.text: You pull on the large wooden doors...

entering-west-ardougne-talking-to-men-an.speaker: Woman
entering-west-ardougne-talking-to-men-an.text: Bah, those mourners... they're meant to be helping us, but I think they're doing more harm here than good. They won't even let me send a letter out to my family.

options.text: Have you seen a lady called Elena around here?

steps.player: Have you seen a lady called Elena around here?

steps.speaker: Woman
steps.text: Yes, I've seen her. Very helpful person.

steps.speaker: Woman
steps.text: Not for the last few days though... I thought maybe she'd gone home.

options.text: You should stand up to them more.

steps.player: You should stand up to them more.

steps.speaker: Woman
steps.text: Oh I'm not one to cause a fuss.

options.text: Yes, living in a plague city must be hard.

steps.player: Yes, living in a plague city must be hard.

steps.speaker: Woman
steps.text: Plague? Pah, that's no excuse for the treatment we've received. It's obvious pretty quickly if someone has the plague.

steps.speaker: Woman
steps.text: I'm thinking about making a break for it. I'm perfectly healthy, not gonna infect anyone.

steps.speaker: Woman
steps.text: Well, ain't much either you or me can do about it.

options.text: I'm looking for a lady called Elena.

steps.player: I'm looking for a lady called Elena.

steps.speaker: Woman
steps.text: I've not heard of her. Old Jethick knows a lot of people, maybe he'll know where you can find her.

entering-west-ardougne-talking-to-men-an.speaker: Woman
entering-west-ardougne-talking-to-men-an.text: We don't have good days here anymore. Curse King Tyras.

steps.speaker: Woman
steps.text: His army curses our city with this plague then wanders off again, leaving us to clear up the pieces.

options.text: I'm looking for a woman called Elena.

steps.player: I'm looking for a woman called Elena.

steps.speaker: Woman
steps.text: Not heard of her.

entering-west-ardougne-talking-to-men-an.speaker: Woman
entering-west-ardougne-talking-to-men-an.text: An outsider! Can you get me out of this hell hole?

entering-west-ardougne-talking-to-men-an.player: Sorry, that's not what I'm here to do.

entering-west-ardougne-talking-to-men-an.speaker: Man
entering-west-ardougne-talking-to-men-an.text: We don't have good days here anymore. Curse King Tyras.

steps.speaker: Man
steps.text: His army curses our city with this plague then wanders off again, leaving us to clear up the pieces.

options.text: I'm looking for a woman called Elena.

steps.player: I'm looking for a woman called Elena.

steps.speaker: Man
steps.text: Not heard of her.

entering-west-ardougne-talking-to-mourne.speaker: Mourner
entering-west-ardougne-talking-to-mourne.text: Hmmm, how did you get over here? You're not one of this rabble. Ah well, you'll have to stay. Can't risk you going back now.

steps.speaker: Mourner
steps.text: We're working for King Lathas of East Ardougne. He has tasked us with containing the accursed plague sweeping West Ardougne.

steps.speaker: Mourner
steps.text: We also do our best to ease these people's suffering. We're nicknamed mourners because we spend a lot of time at plague victim funerals, no one else is allowed to risk attending.

steps.speaker: Mourner
steps.text: It's a demanding job, and we get little thanks from the people here.

options.text: I haven't got the plague though...

steps.player: I haven't got the plague though...

steps.speaker: Mourner
steps.text: Can't risk you being a carrier. That protective clothing you have isn't regulation issue. It won't meet safety standards.

options.text: I'm looking for a woman named Elena.

steps.player: I'm looking for a woman named Elena.

steps.speaker: Mourner
steps.text: Ah yes, I've heard of her. A healer I believe. She must be mad coming over here voluntarily.

steps.speaker: Mourner
steps.text: I hear rumours she has probably caught the plague now. Very tragic, a stupid waste of life.

entering-west-ardougne-talking-to-ted-re.speaker: Ted Rehnison
entering-west-ardougne-talking-to-ted-re.text: Go away. We don't want any.

entering-west-ardougne-talking-to-jethic.speaker: Jethick
entering-west-ardougne-talking-to-jethic.text: Hello, I don't recognise you. We don't get many newcomers around here.

entering-west-ardougne-talking-to-jethic.speaker: Jethick
entering-west-ardougne-talking-to-jethic.text: The plague of course. Not many people want to come to a place like this and the few that do normally get stopped by the mourners.

entering-west-ardougne-talking-to-jethic.speaker: Jethick
entering-west-ardougne-talking-to-jethic.text: All you'll find here now are the dead and the dying. Even our own king has abandoned us.

entering-west-ardougne-talking-to-jethic.speaker: Jethick
entering-west-ardougne-talking-to-jethic.text: Yes, King Tyras of West Ardougne. He's the brother of King Lathas, the ruler of East Ardougne.

entering-west-ardougne-talking-to-jethic.speaker: Jethick
entering-west-ardougne-talking-to-jethic.text: Well he's always been a bit of an explorer. He's led multiple expeditions into the uncharted lands to the west.

entering-west-ardougne-talking-to-jethic.speaker: Jethick
entering-west-ardougne-talking-to-jethic.text: The plague first started when he came back from one of these expeditions. More than a few suspect that some of his men caught it out there and brought it back with them.

entering-west-ardougne-talking-to-jethic.speaker: Jethick
entering-west-ardougne-talking-to-jethic.text: The king didn't care though. He just left on another expedition to the west. He hasn't been seen since. He left the city warder Bravek in charge but he's no better.

entering-west-ardougne-talking-to-jethic.speaker: Jethick
entering-west-ardougne-talking-to-jethic.text: Anyway, you clearly didn't come here to talk about kings. So tell me, what brings you to West Ardougne?

entering-west-ardougne-talking-to-jethic.player: I'm looking for a woman from East Ardougne called Elena.

entering-west-ardougne-talking-to-jethic.speaker: Jethick
entering-west-ardougne-talking-to-jethic.text: East Ardougnian women are easier to find in East Ardougne. Not many would come to West Ardougne to find one. Although the name is familiar, what does she look like?

entering-west-ardougne-talking-to-jethic.player: Um... brown hair... in her twenties...

entering-west-ardougne-talking-to-jethic.speaker: Jethick
entering-west-ardougne-talking-to-jethic.text: Hmmm, that doesn't narrow it down a huge amount... I'll need to know more than that, or see a picture?

entering-west-ardougne-talking-to-main-c.speaker: Clerk
entering-west-ardougne-talking-to-main-c.text: Hello, welcome to the Civic Office of West Ardougne. How can I help you?

steps.speaker: Clerk
steps.text: The city warder Bravek is in there.

steps.speaker: Clerk
steps.text: He has asked not to be disturbed.

entering-west-ardougne-talking-to-other-.speaker: Clerk
entering-west-ardougne-talking-to-other-.text: Sorry, I don't have time to talk. Bravek needs lots of help running the city.

entering-west-ardougne-talking-to-edmond.player: Not yet, it's a big city over there. Do you have a picture of Elena?

entering-west-ardougne-talking-to-edmond.speaker: Edmond
entering-west-ardougne-talking-to-edmond.text: There should be a picture of Elena in the house. Please find her quickly, I hope it's not too late.

entering-west-ardougne-talking-to-alrena.speaker: Alrena
entering-west-ardougne-talking-to-alrena.text: Is there anything else I can do to help?

entering-west-ardougne-talking-to-alrena.player: Do you have a picture of Elena?

entering-west-ardougne-talking-to-alrena.speaker: Alrena
entering-west-ardougne-talking-to-alrena.text: Yes. There should be one in the house somewhere. Let me know if you need anything else.

steps.speaker: Jethick
steps.text: Hello, I don't recognise you. We don't get many newcomers around here.

finding-elena-talking-to-jethick-after-g.text: If the player has talked to Jethick before:

steps.speaker: Jethick
steps.text: Hello. We don't get many newcomers around here.

finding-elena-talking-to-jethick-after-g.player: I'm looking for a woman from East Ardougne called Elena.

finding-elena-talking-to-jethick-after-g.speaker: Jethick
finding-elena-talking-to-jethick-after-g.text: East Ardougnian women are easier to find in East Ardougne. Not many would come to West Ardougne to find one. Although the name is familiar, what does she look like?

finding-elena-talking-to-jethick-after-g.speaker: Jethick
finding-elena-talking-to-jethick-after-g.text: Ah yes. She came over here to help the plague victims. I think she is staying over with the Rehnison family.

finding-elena-talking-to-jethick-after-g.speaker: Jethick
finding-elena-talking-to-jethick-after-g.text: They live in the small timbered building at the far north side of town. I've not seen her around here in a while, mind.

finding-elena-talking-to-jethick-after-g.speaker: Jethick
finding-elena-talking-to-jethick-after-g.text: I don't suppose you could run me a little errand while you're over there? I borrowed this book from them, can you return it?

options.text: Yes, I'll return it for you.

steps.player: Yes, I'll return it for you.

steps.text: If the player has no inventory space:
Jethick shows you the book, but you don't have room to take it.
Jethick gives you a book.

options.text: No, I don't have time for that.

steps.player: No, I don't have time for that.

finding-elena-talking-to-jethick-after-g.speaker: Jethick
finding-elena-talking-to-jethick-after-g.text: Hello. We don't get many newcomers around here.

finding-elena-talking-to-jethick-after-g.player: I'm looking for a woman from East Ardougne called Elena.

finding-elena-talking-to-jethick-after-g.speaker: Jethick
finding-elena-talking-to-jethick-after-g.text: Ah yes. She came over here to help the plague victims. I think she is staying over with the Rehnison family.

finding-elena-talking-to-jethick-after-g.speaker: Jethick
finding-elena-talking-to-jethick-after-g.text: They live in the small timbered building at the far north side of town. I've not seen her around here in a while, mind.

finding-elena-returning-the-book-to-ted-.speaker: Ted Rehnison
finding-elena-returning-the-book-to-ted-.text: Go away. We don't want any.

finding-elena-returning-the-book-to-ted-.player: I'm a friend of Jethick's, I have come to return a book he borrowed.

finding-elena-returning-the-book-to-ted-.speaker: Ted Rehnison
finding-elena-returning-the-book-to-ted-.text: Oh... Why didn't you say, come in then.
You hand the book to Ted as you enter.

finding-elena-talking-to-jethick-after-d.speaker: Jethick
finding-elena-talking-to-jethick-after-d.text: Hello. We don't get many newcomers around here.

finding-elena-talking-to-martha-rehnison.player: Hi, I hear a woman called Elena is staying here.

finding-elena-talking-to-martha-rehnison.speaker: Martha Rehnison
finding-elena-talking-to-martha-rehnison.text: Yes she was staying here, but slightly over a week ago she was getting ready to go back. However she never managed to leave.

finding-elena-talking-to-martha-rehnison.speaker: Martha Rehnison
finding-elena-talking-to-martha-rehnison.text: My daughter Milli was playing near the west wall when she saw some shadowy figures jump out and grab her. Milli is upstairs if you wish to speak to her.

finding-elena-talking-to-ted-rehnison.player: Hi, I hear a woman called Elena is staying here.

finding-elena-talking-to-ted-rehnison.speaker: Ted Rehnison
finding-elena-talking-to-ted-rehnison.text: Yes she was staying here, but slightly over a week ago she was getting ready to go back. However she never managed to leave.

finding-elena-talking-to-ted-rehnison.speaker: Ted Rehnison
finding-elena-talking-to-ted-rehnison.text: My daughter Milli was playing near the west wall when she saw some shadowy figures jump out and grab her. Milli is upstairs if you wish to speak to her.

finding-elena-talking-to-milli-rehnison.player: Hello. Your parents say you saw what happened to Elena...

finding-elena-talking-to-milli-rehnison.speaker: Milli Rehnison
finding-elena-talking-to-milli-rehnison.text: sniff* Yes I was near the south east corner when I saw Elena walking by. I was about to run to greet her when some men jumped out. They shoved a sack over her head and dragged her into a building.

finding-elena-talking-to-milli-rehnison.speaker: Milli Rehnison
finding-elena-talking-to-milli-rehnison.text: It was the boarded up building with no windows in the south east corner of West Ardougne.

finding-elena-talking-to-ted-rehnison-af.speaker: Ted Rehnison
finding-elena-talking-to-ted-rehnison-af.text: I wish you luck, she did a lot for us.

finding-elena-talking-to-martha-rehnison.speaker: Martha Rehnison
finding-elena-talking-to-martha-rehnison.text: I wish you luck, she did a lot for us.

finding-elena-attempting-to-enter-the-pl.text: The door won't open. You notice a black cross on the door.

finding-elena-attempting-to-enter-the-pl.speaker: Mourner
finding-elena-attempting-to-enter-the-pl.text: I'd stand away from there. That black cross means that house has been touched by the plague.

options.text: But I think a kidnap victim is in here.

steps.player: But I think a kidnap victim is in here.

steps.speaker: Mourner
steps.text: Sounds unlikely, even kidnappers wouldn't go in there. Even if someone is in there, they're probably dead by now.

steps.speaker: Mourner
steps.text: You don't have clearance to go in there.

steps.speaker: Mourner
steps.text: Well you'd need to apply to the head mourner, or I suppose Bravek the city warder.

steps.speaker: Mourner
steps.text: I wouldn't get your hopes up though.

options.text: I fear not a mere plague.

steps.player: I fear not a mere plague.

steps.speaker: Mourner
steps.text: That's irrelevant. You don't have clearance to go in there.

steps.speaker: Mourner
steps.text: Well you'd need to apply to the head mourner, or I suppose Bravek the city warder.

steps.speaker: Mourner
steps.text: I wouldn't get your hopes up though.

finding-elena-attempting-to-enter-the-pl.text: The door won't open. You notice a black cross on the door.

finding-elena-attempting-to-enter-the-pl.speaker: Mourner
finding-elena-attempting-to-enter-the-pl.text: I'd stand away from there. That black cross means that house has been touched by the plague.

finding-elena-talking-to-milli-rehnison-.speaker: Milli Rehnison
finding-elena-talking-to-milli-rehnison-.text: I hope you find her. She was nice.

finding-elena-talking-to-head-mourner-af.speaker: Head Mourner
finding-elena-talking-to-head-mourner-af.text: How did you get into West Ardougne? Ah well you'll have to stay, can't risk you spreading the plague outside.

options.text: I need clearance to enter a plague house.

steps.player: I need clearance to enter a plague house. It's in the south east corner of West Ardougne.

steps.speaker: Head Mourner
steps.text: You must be nuts, absolutely not!

steps.speaker: Head Mourner
steps.text: Well they're as good as dead then, no point in trying to save them.

options.text: I've got a gas mask though...

steps.player: I've got a gas mask though...

steps.speaker: Head Mourner
steps.text: It's not regulation. Anyway you're not properly trained to deal with the plague.

steps.speaker: Head Mourner
steps.text: It requires a strict 18 months of training.

steps.player: I don't have that sort of time.

steps.speaker: Head Mourner
steps.text: You're wasting my time, I have a lot of work to do!

options.text: I haven't got the plague though...
I'm looking for a woman named Elena.

finding-elena-attempting-to-open-the-doo.speaker: Bravek
finding-elena-attempting-to-open-the-doo.text: Go away, I'm busy! I'm... Umm... In a meeting!

finding-elena-talking-to-the-clerk-befor.speaker: Clerk
finding-elena-talking-to-the-clerk-befor.text: Hello, welcome to the Civic Office of West Ardougne. How can I help you?

options.text: I need permission to enter a plague house.

steps.player: I need permission to enter a plague house.

steps.speaker: Clerk
steps.text: Rather you than me! The mourners normally deal with that stuff, you should speak to them. Their headquarters are right near the city gate.

options.text: Surely you don't let them run everything for you?

steps.player: Surely you don't let them run everything for you?

steps.speaker: Clerk
steps.text: Well, they do know what they're doing here. If they did start doing something badly Bravek, the city warder, would have the power to override them. I can't see that happening though.

options.text: Can I speak to Bravek anyway?

steps.player: Can I speak to Bravek anyway?

steps.speaker: Clerk
steps.text: He has asked not to be disturbed.

options.text: This is urgent though! Someone's been kidnapped!
Do you know when he will be available?
This is urgent though! Someone's been kidnapped!

steps.speaker: Clerk
steps.text: The city warder Bravek is in there.

steps.speaker: Clerk
steps.text: He has asked not to be disturbed.

options.text: This is urgent though! Someone's been kidnapped!

steps.player: This is urgent though! Someone's been kidnapped!

steps.speaker: Clerk
steps.text: I'll see what I can do I suppose.

steps.speaker: Clerk
steps.text: Mr Bravek, there's [a man/a lady/someone] here who really needs to speak to you.

steps.speaker: Bravek
steps.text: I suppose they can come in then. If they keep it short.

options.text: Do you know when he will be available?

steps.player: Do you know when he will be available?

steps.speaker: Clerk
steps.text: Oh I don't know, an hour or so maybe.

finding-elena-talking-to-the-clerk-after.speaker: Clerk
finding-elena-talking-to-the-clerk-after.text: Bravek will see you now but keep it short!

finding-elena-talking-to-the-clerk-after.player: Thanks, I won't take much of his time.

finding-elena-talking-to-bravek.speaker: Bravek
finding-elena-talking-to-bravek.text: My head hurts! I'll speak to you another day...

steps.speaker: Bravek
steps.text: I can't possibly speak to you with my head spinning like this... I went a bit heavy on the drink again last night. Curse my herbalist, she made the best hang over cures. Darn inconvenient of her catching the plague.

options.text: You shouldn't drink so much then!

steps.player: You shouldn't drink so much then!

steps.speaker: Bravek
steps.text: Well positions of responsibility are hard, I need something to take my mind off things... Especially with the problems this place has.

options.text: Do you know what's in the cure?
I don't think drink is the solution.

steps.player: I don't think drink is the solution.

steps.speaker: Bravek
steps.text: I don't feel well enough to have a philosophical discussion about it right now. My head hurts.

options.text: Do you know what's in the cure?
Do you know what's in the cure?

steps.player: Do you know what's in the cure?

steps.speaker: Bravek
steps.text: Hmmm let me think... Ouch! Thinking isn't clever. Ah here, she did scribble it down for me.
If the player has no inventory space:
Bravek waves a tatty piece of paper at you, but you don't have room to take it.
Bravek hands you a tatty piece of paper.

finding-elena-talking-to-bravek-talking-.speaker: Bravek
finding-elena-talking-to-bravek-talking-.text: Uurgh! My head still hurts too much to think straight. Oh for one of Trudi's hangover cures!
If the player lost the scruffy note:

steps.player: Do you know what's in the cure?

steps.speaker: Bravek
steps.text: Hmmm let me think... Ouch! Thinking isn't clever. Ah here, she did scribble it down for me.
If the player has no inventory space:
Bravek waves a tatty piece of paper at you, but you don't have room to take it.
Bravek hands you a tatty piece of paper.

finding-elena-mixing-the-hangover-cure-u.text: You mix the chocolate into the bucket.
You mix the snape grass into the bucket.

finding-elena-talking-to-bravek-after-ge.speaker: Bravek
finding-elena-talking-to-bravek-after-ge.text: Uurgh! My head still hurts too much to think straight. Oh for one of Trudi's hangover cures!
You give Bravek the hangover cure. Bravek gulps down the foul-looking liquid.

finding-elena-talking-to-bravek-after-ge.speaker: Bravek
finding-elena-talking-to-bravek-after-ge.text: Ooh that's much better! Thanks, that's the clearest my head has felt in a month. Ah now, what was it you wanted me to do for you?

finding-elena-talking-to-bravek-after-ge.player: I need to rescue a kidnap victim called Elena. She's being held in a plague house, I need permission to enter.

finding-elena-talking-to-bravek-after-ge.speaker: Bravek
finding-elena-talking-to-bravek-after-ge.text: Well the mourners deal with that sort of thing...

options.text: Okay, I'll go speak to them.

steps.player: Okay, I'll go speak to them.

options.text: Is that all anyone says around here?

steps.player: Is that all anyone says around here?

steps.speaker: Bravek
steps.text: Well, they know best about plague issues.

options.text: Don't you want to take an interest in it at all?

steps.player: Don't you want to take an interest in it at all?

steps.speaker: Bravek
steps.text: Nope, I don't wish to take a deep interest in plagues. That stuff is too scary for me!

options.text: I see why people say you're a weak leader.

steps.player: I see why people say you're a weak leader.

steps.speaker: Bravek
steps.text: Bah, people always criticise their leaders but delegating is the only way to lead. I delegate all plague issues to the mourners.

steps.player: This whole city is a plague issue!

options.text: Okay, I'll talk to the mourners.

steps.player: Okay, I'll talk to the mourners.
They say I'm not properly equipped to go in the house, though I do have a very effective gas mask.

steps.speaker: Bravek
steps.text: Hmmm, well I guess they're not taking the issue of a kidnapping seriously enough. They do go a bit far sometimes.

steps.speaker: Bravek
steps.text: I've heard of Elena, she has helped us a lot... Okay, I'll give you this warrant to enter the house.
If the player has no inventory space:
Bravek waves a warrant at you, but you don't have room to take it.
Bravek hands you a warrant.

finding-elena-talking-to-bravek-before-g.speaker: Bravek
finding-elena-talking-to-bravek-before-g.text: Thanks again for the hangover cure.

finding-elena-talking-to-bravek-before-g.speaker: Bravek
finding-elena-talking-to-bravek-before-g.text: Ah now what was it you wanted me to do for you?

finding-elena-talking-to-bravek-before-g.player: I need to rescue Elena. She's now a kidnap victim! She's being held in a plague house, I need permission to enter.

finding-elena-talking-to-bravek-before-g.speaker: Bravek
finding-elena-talking-to-bravek-before-g.text: Well the mourners deal with that sort of thing...

options.text: Okay, I'll go speak to them.
Is that all anyone says around here?

finding-elena-talking-to-bravek-after-re.speaker: Bravek
finding-elena-talking-to-bravek-after-re.text: Thanks again for the hangover cure.

finding-elena-talking-to-bravek-after-re.player: Not a problem, happy to help out.

finding-elena-talking-to-bravek-after-re.speaker: Bravek
finding-elena-talking-to-bravek-after-re.text: I'm just having a little drop of whisky, then I'll feel really good.

finding-elena-talking-to-clerk-after-mee.speaker: Clerk
finding-elena-talking-to-clerk-after-mee.text: Hello, welcome to the Civic Office of West Ardougne. How can I help you?

steps.speaker: Clerk
steps.text: The city warder Bravek is in there.

steps.speaker: Clerk
steps.text: I suppose so.

freeing-elena-attempting-to-enter-the-pl.text: The door won't open. You notice a black cross on the door.

freeing-elena-attempting-to-enter-the-pl.speaker: Mourner
freeing-elena-attempting-to-enter-the-pl.text: I'd stand away from there. That black cross means that house has been touched by the plague.

freeing-elena-attempting-to-enter-the-pl.player: I have a warrant from Bravek to enter here.

freeing-elena-attempting-to-enter-the-pl.speaker: Mourner
freeing-elena-attempting-to-enter-the-pl.text: This is highly irregular. Please wait...

freeing-elena-attempting-to-enter-the-pl.speaker: Mourner
freeing-elena-attempting-to-enter-the-pl.text: Hey... I've got someone here with a warrant from Bravek, what should we do?

freeing-elena-attempting-to-enter-the-pl.speaker: Mourner (2)
freeing-elena-attempting-to-enter-the-pl.text: Well you can't let them in...
You wait until the mourner's back is turned and sneak into the building.

freeing-elena-talking-to-mourners-outsid.player: I have a warrant from Bravek to enter here.

freeing-elena-talking-to-mourners-outsid.speaker: Mourner
freeing-elena-talking-to-mourners-outsid.text: This is highly irregular. Please wait...
You wait until the mourner's back is turned and sneak into the building.

freeing-elena-attempting-to-open-the-bas.speaker: Elena
freeing-elena-attempting-to-open-the-bas.text: Hey get me out of here please!

freeing-elena-attempting-to-open-the-bas.player: I would do but I don't have a key.

freeing-elena-attempting-to-open-the-bas.speaker: Elena
freeing-elena-attempting-to-open-the-bas.text: I think there may be one around somewhere. I'm sure I heard them stashing it somewhere.

steps.speaker: Elena
steps.text: No, I have none of the symptoms.

steps.player: Strange, I was told this house was plague infected.

steps.speaker: Elena
steps.text: I suppose that was a cover up by the kidnappers.

freeing-elena-searching-the-barrel.text: You find a small key in the barrel.

freeing-elena-talking-to-elena-after-unl.player: Hi, you're free to go! Your kidnappers don't seem to be about right now.

freeing-elena-talking-to-elena-after-unl.speaker: Elena
freeing-elena-talking-to-elena-after-unl.text: Thank you, being kidnapped was so inconvenient. I was on my way back to East Ardougne with some samples, I want to see if I can diagnose a cure for this plague.

freeing-elena-talking-to-elena-after-unl.player: Well you can leave via the manhole in the middle of the city.

freeing-elena-talking-to-elena-after-unl.speaker: Elena
freeing-elena-talking-to-elena-after-unl.text: Go and see my father, I'll make sure he adequately rewards you. Now I'd better leave while I still can.

after-freeing-elena-talking-to-ted-rehni.player: Yes, she is safe at home now.

after-freeing-elena-talking-to-ted-rehni.speaker: Ted Rehnison
after-freeing-elena-talking-to-ted-rehni.text: That's good to hear, she helped us a lot.

after-freeing-elena-talking-to-martha-af.speaker: Martha Rehnison
after-freeing-elena-talking-to-martha-af.text: That's good to hear, she helped us a lot.

after-freeing-elena-talking-to-alrena-af.speaker: Alrena
after-freeing-elena-talking-to-alrena-af.text: Thank you for rescuing my daughter! Elena has told me of your bravery in entering a house that could have been plague infected. I can't thank you enough!

after-freeing-elena-edmond.speaker: Edmond
after-freeing-elena-edmond.text: Thank you, thank you! Elena beat you back by minutes. Now I said I'd give you a reward. What can I give you as a reward I wonder? Here take this magic scroll, I have little use for it but it may help you.

after-freeing-elena-edmond.speaker: Edmond
after-freeing-elena-edmond.text: Now I'd recommend you go and see Elena. She'll want to thank you herself. She lives in the house opposite ours.

after-freeing-elena-edmond-talking-to-ed.speaker: Edmond
after-freeing-elena-edmond-talking-to-ed.text: Ah hello. Thank you again for rescuing my daughter.

options.text: Do you have any more of those scrolls?

steps.player: Do you have any more of those scrolls?

steps.speaker: Edmond
steps.text: Yes, here you go.

after-freeing-elena-edmond-using-the-tel.text: You memorise what is written on the scroll. You can now use the Ardougne Teleport Spell.
